originStory.title: Why Knowii Exists
originStory.subtitle: More than knowledge management. A complete system for thriving.
originStory.story: I didn't build Knowii just because I was overwhelmed by information. I built it because I needed systems that worked through everything life threw at me: a failed startup that cost 200k€ and two years. Crushing shyness that made me terrified of communication. The painful transition from introverted engineer to leader and manager. Burnout from trying to do everything through willpower. Losing loved ones and questioning what really matters. Raising three kids while building a business alongside a demanding corporate career. Through all of this, I realized that information overload was just one symptom of a deeper problem. What I actually needed, what we all need, is a complete system for clarity, learning, organization, and execution. Not just a place to store notes, but systems that help us know what matters, manage our careers, learn effectively, stay organized, and actually get things done. That's what Knowii delivers: a community of practice where we share not just knowledge management techniques, but the full toolkit for thriving as a modern knowledge worker.
originStory.inspirationPoint: Knowledge management is the foundation. But clarity, habits, career management, learning, and execution are what make the difference between surviving and thriving.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years Building Systems for Everything
creatorJourney.subtitle: Not just PKM. The complete knowledge worker toolkit.
creatorJourney.story: I've been coding since age 8 and writing almost as long. In my IT career, I've been a software developer, technical lead, software architect, solution architect, infrastructure architect, IT security expert, team leader, project manager, CTO, and founder. Today, I work half-time as an IT Solution Architect for a major financial organization while running DeveloPassion, raising 3 kids, and maintaining nearly 10,000 notes in my personal knowledge system. I've published 3 books, written 400+ articles and newsletters, created courses, and built products used by thousands. But here's what matters: I didn't just build systems for managing information. I built systems for everything. Clarity on values and priorities, habits that make productivity automatic, career management, effective learning, project organization, task management, focus and attention, and personal development. The Knowii Community is where I share ALL of it. Not just PKM, but the complete framework for becoming a top-tier knowledge worker.
